## AI chat to service ticket
Chatwoot Agent Bot webhook -> LLM (classify + extract) -> decision logic -> Odoo task -> reply / hand off.

1. Change the webhook path to a long random string.
2. Edit the **Config** node.
3. Create three Header Auth credentials: **LLM API key**, **Odoo API key**, **Chatwoot bot token** (see README).

Code nodes are generated from `src/` by `scripts/build-workflow.js`.

parameters.jsCode:
// Business facts and settings. Secrets do NOT go here; they live in n8n credentials.
return [{ json: {
  "business_name": "Stonebridge Plumbing",
  "business_facts": [
    "Stonebridge Plumbing is a residential and light-commercial plumbing company.",
    "Office hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm. The chat is answered any time; urgent problems get a person right away.",
    "Service area: Stonebridge, Millbrook and Cedar Falls (demo towns).",
    "Services: water heaters (tank and tankless), leaks and burst pipes, drain cleaning, repiping, fixtures (faucets, toilets, sinks), sump pumps, leak detection.",
    "Prices are never quoted in chat: the plumber looks at the job first and gives the price before starting work.",
    "The plumber phones the customer before heading over."
  ],
  "llm_base_url": "https://api.openai.com/v1",
  "llm_model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "llm_json_mode": true,
  "llm_max_tokens": 400,
  "llm_temperature": 0.2,
  "min_confidence": 0.6,
  "odoo_url": "http://odoo:8069",
  "odoo_db": "servicedesk",
  "odoo_project_id": 1,
  "chatwoot_url": "http://chatwoot:3000",
  "chatwoot_handoff_team_id": null,
  "max_bot_turns": 15,
  "max_message_chars": 1000,
  "max_unsure": 2
} }];
